goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.desc: A scrappy green-skinned scavenger armed with a chipped blade. Bold in numbers, cowardly alone.

goblin_guard.name: Goblin Guard
goblin_guard.desc: A goblin that found a dented shield somewhere. It's more annoying than dangerous.

bat.name: Vampire Bat
bat.desc: A blood-draining cave bat. Evasive and quick. Fragile if you can hit it.

quivering_ooze.name: Quivering Ooze
quivering_ooze.desc: A gelatinous pudding creature. Slow and dim. Blunt weapons bounce off it uselessly.

black_ooze.name: Black Ooze
black_ooze.desc: A darker, denser variant of the common ooze. Leaves a staining residue on anything it touches.

mold_wisp.name: Mold Wisp
mold_wisp.desc: A wisp of wind and spore. It doesn't so much attack as drift into you at speed.

hex_toad.name: Hex Toad
hex_toad.desc: An oversized toad with faintly luminescent skin. Its croak is disorienting at close range.

killer_bee.name: Killer Bee
killer_bee.desc: Fast, venomous, and small enough to be maddening. Usually comes in groups.

pod_creeper.name: Pod Creeper
pod_creeper.desc: A tiny cactus creature that peppers you with needle-fine spines and then scurries off.

reef_raider.name: Reef Raider
reef_raider.desc: A fish-man that haunts the Tricklebrook and the soggy edges of the Whisperwood. Smells terrible.

stalk_lurker.name: Stalk Lurker
stalk_lurker.desc: A many-limbed thing that clings to cave ceilings. Drops on you when you walk underneath.

blood_slime.name: Blood Slime
blood_slime.desc: A crimson ooze that seeps under doors and through cracks. It digests things slowly and completely.

mote_swarm.name: Mote Swarm
mote_swarm.desc: A floating cloud of animate ash, remnant of something burned long ago.

bramble_grub.name: Bramble Grub
bramble_grub.desc: A tentacled plant creature that roots itself near water and grabs passing legs.

acorn_imp.name: Acorn Imp
acorn_imp.desc: An oversized squirrel with a mean disposition and a habit of hoarding sharp things.

forest_boar.name: Forest Boar
forest_boar.desc: A tusked pig that charges when startled. Startles easily.

snipper.name: Snipper
snipper.desc: A large crab that wandered far from any water. Confused and aggressive.

spore_folk.name: Spore Folk
spore_folk.desc: A walking mushroom creature that releases confusion spores when struck.

mud_ooze.name: Mud Ooze
mud_ooze.desc: A ooze variant made of mud rather than gelatine. Slower, dirtier, equally unpleasant.

leaf_bunny.name: Leaf Bunny
leaf_bunny.desc: A small creature that looks harmless. Bites hard and bolts. Usually gone before you can react.

thorn_lizard.name: Thorn Lizard
thorn_lizard.desc: A relative of the lizardman that never outgrew its spikes. Hard to grab.

snow_bunny.name: Snow Bunny
snow_bunny.desc: A white rabbit with eyes like chips of ice. Incredibly fast. Bites when cornered. Winter only.

ice_wisp.name: Ice Wisp
ice_wisp.desc: A floating light that appears on frozen nights. Cold radiates from it. Drops nothing.

bloom_creeper.name: Bloom Creeper
bloom_creeper.desc: A vine creature that only mobilizes in spring when new growth gives it reach. Smells like flowers. Strangles things.

summer_hornet.name: Summer Hornet
summer_hornet.desc: A hornet the size of a fist. Summer heat makes them aggressive. Nests near the Whisperwood edge in July and August.

wisp.name: Will-o'-Wisp
wisp.desc: A floating light. It draws you off the path and then attacks. Classic. Drops nothing.

shadow_hound.name: Shadow Hound
shadow_hound.desc: A dog-shaped shadow that has developed opinions about territory.

fire_beetle.name: Fire Beetle
fire_beetle.desc: A beetle the size of a dog with a glowing thorax. Bites leave minor burns. Common near warm rocks.

large_bat.name: Large Bat
large_bat.desc: A bat with a wingspan wider than a man's arms. Echolocation makes it hard to surprise.

gnoll_pup.name: Gnoll Pup
gnoll_pup.desc: A young hyena-man. Scrawny and mean. Already knows how to hold a weapon.

decaying_skeleton.name: Decaying Skeleton
decaying_skeleton.desc: Barely held together by old magic. Falls apart if hit hard enough. Reassembles if you don't finish it.

spiderling.name: Spiderling
spiderling.desc: A young forest spider. Fast, venomous, and angry about being small.

hornet.name: Hornet
hornet.desc: A wasp the length of a forearm. Stings paralyze smaller creatures. You are not a smaller creature. Probably.

imp.name: Imp
imp.desc: A tiny devil-creature with bat wings. Throws sparks and insults. Annoying beyond its threat level.

leg_eater.name: Leg Eater
leg_eater.desc: A carnivorous plant that snaps at ankles. Sessile until you step on it.

wererat.name: Wererat
wererat.desc: A rat that walks upright and carries a shiv. Found near sewers and basements. Clever enough to ambush.

kobold.name: Kobold
kobold.desc: A small, reptilian humanoid. Draconic in lineage, but cowardly in practice. Usually found in large, annoying numbers.

giant_rat.name: Giant Rat
giant_rat.desc: An unnaturally large rodent. Its bite is infectious and its hunger is bottomless.

goblin_pathfinder.name: Goblin Pathfinder
goblin_pathfinder.desc: A frantic goblin that knows the shortcuts. It'll lead you straight to your doom if you aren't careful.

thornwood_scout.name: Thornwood Scout
thornwood_scout.desc: An elf from a distant woodland. Skilled in woodcraft and defensive strikes.

cave_crawler.name: Cave Crawler
cave_crawler.desc: A multi-legged insectoid that clings to cave ceilings. Drops on unsuspecting prey.

slime.name: Slime
slime.desc: A quiver of jelly. Hard to hurt with a blade, but weak to almost everything else.

stirge.name: Stirge
stirge.desc: A winged insect-bird that drains blood. They are rarely alone.

giant_centipede.name: Giant Centipede
giant_centipede.desc: A massive multi-legged horror. Its mandibles drip with a numbing toxin.

mudbrawler.name: Mudbrawler
mudbrawler.desc: A goblinoid creature that thrives in filth and chaos. It fights with clumsy but heavy strikes.

homunculus.name: Homunculus
homunculus.desc: A tiny, artificial humanoid. It follows its master's telepathic commands with eerie precision.

moss_pygmy.name: Moss Pygmy
moss_pygmy.desc: A fungal creature spawned from the remains of others. It communicates through rhythmic thumping.

burrow_knave.name: Burrow Knave
burrow_knave.desc: A small, blue-skinned humanoid that worships a minor god of thievery. They are greedy and paranoid.

mud_element.name: Mud Element
mud_element.desc: A sludge-like creature that slows anyone who steps into its reach.

hand_axe_goblin.name: Hand Axe Goblin
hand_axe_goblin.desc: A goblin with better equipment and worse manners. Throws hand axes before charging.

skeleton_archer.name: Skeleton Archer
skeleton_archer.desc: A skeleton that still remembers how to draw a bow. Its aim is disturbingly good.

skeleton.name: Skeleton
skeleton.desc: Animated bone. Slow, relentless. Takes reduced damage from slashing weapons. Fire works.

zombie.name: Zombie
zombie.desc: A shambling corpse. Nearly unstoppable through attrition alone. Burns well.

ghoul.name: Ghoul
ghoul.desc: A grave-robber's nightmare. Fast for undead, and it remembers how to use its hands.

wolf.name: Dire Wolf
wolf.desc: A large ash-grey wolf with black eyes. Hunts in packs. Faster than it looks.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.desc: A flickering translucent figure. Hard to hit. Cold radiates outward from it. Drops nothing.

black_goblin.name: Black Goblin
black_goblin.desc: A smarter, meaner cousin of the common goblin. Carries poison on its blade.

cockatrice.name: Cockatrice
cockatrice.desc: A two-legged bird with a snake's tail and a petrifying gaze. Keep your eyes down.

steel_bat.name: Steel Bat
steel_bat.desc: A bat with hide like hammered iron. Its wing-buffets hit harder than they should.

gigas.name: Gigas
gigas.desc: A dim-witted giant barely taller than a man. More momentum than malice.

lizardman.name: Lizardman
lizardman.desc: An armored reptilian warrior. Disciplined, moves in squads, fights without ego.

harpy.name: Harpy
harpy.desc: A winged woman with talons. Attacks from above, retreats before you close distance.

puffcap.name: Puffcap
puffcap.desc: A rosy floating creature that looks harmless. It's mostly harmless. But it's full of gold for some reason.

moth.name: Skull Eater
moth.desc: Tiny, incredibly fast, and vicious. Almost impossible to hit. If you manage it, it was worth it.

sea_snake.name: Sea Snake
sea_snake.desc: Found near the Tricklebrook and any standing water. Faster in mud than you'd expect.

bandit.name: Road Bandit
bandit.desc: A desperate man with a blade. The trade road made him this way. He's made his choice.

bandit_captain.name: Bandit Captain
bandit_captain.desc: The ruthless commander of the Trade Road blockade. Wields twin poisoned daggers and wears reinforced brigandine.

frost_wolf.name: Frost Wolf
frost_wolf.desc: A pale grey wolf with ice-rimed fur. Hunts alone in winter when the pack disperses. Faster than its summer cousin.

snow_bandit.name: Desperate Bandit
snow_bandit.desc: A road bandit in winter furs. Hungrier and less careful than his summer counterpart. Will fight harder.

antler_stag.name: Antler Stag
antler_stag.desc: An enormous stag driven to the forest edge by autumn hunger. Antlers like branches. Not aggressive — until it is.

gnoll.name: Gnoll
gnoll.desc: A full-grown hyena-man. Hunts in packs. Laughs before it charges. The laugh is worse.

orc_pawn.name: Orc Pawn
orc_pawn.desc: An orc foot soldier. Disciplined, armored, and expendable. There are always more.

orc_centurion.name: Orc Centurion
orc_centurion.desc: An orc officer. Better armor, better weapon, worse attitude. Commands squads of pawns.

basilisk.name: Basilisk
basilisk.desc: An eight-legged reptile with a petrifying gaze. Keep your shield up and your eyes down.

cinder_mote.name: Cinder Mote
cinder_mote.desc: A floating sphere of compressed fire. It gets bigger when you hit it. Then it explodes.

lash_cat.name: Lash Cat
lash_cat.desc: A panther-like predator with whip-like whiskers that discharge lightning. Silent until it strikes.

ember_bloat.name: Ember Bloat
ember_bloat.desc: A bomb that has been burning long enough to develop opinions. Larger, angrier, redder.

snap_eel.name: Snap Eel
snap_eel.desc: A carnivorous fish that has grown legs and a foul temper. Found near Tricklebrook. Surprisingly fast on land.

revenant.name: Revenant
revenant.desc: An undead warrior with enough memory to hold a grudge. Attacks with purpose, not instinct.

gnoll_hunter.name: Gnoll Hunter
gnoll_hunter.desc: A gnoll that has mastered the bow. It tracks its prey for miles before striking from the shadows.

bugbear.name: Bugbear
bugbear.desc: A hulking, hairy goblinoid. Surprisingly stealthy for its size. Hits with the force of a falling tree.

rust_monster.name: Rust Monster
rust_monster.desc: An insect-like creature that feeds on metal. Your armor is looking quite delicious to it.

greater_harpy.name: Greater Harpy
greater_harpy.desc: A creature with the upper body of a woman and the lower body of a bird. Its song lures travelers to their deaths.

nightwing_vampire.name: Night-Wing Vampire
nightwing_vampire.desc: A winged predator that drains the life of its victims. It strikes with precision and lethal intent.

crow_folk.name: Crow-Folk
crow_folk.desc: A flightless bird-man. They mimic sounds to lure prey and communicate in whistles and clicks.

lizardfolk.name: Lizardfolk
lizardfolk.desc: Cold-blooded warriors of the swamp. They are efficient hunters and scavengers.

mantis_warrior.name: Mantis Warrior
mantis_warrior.desc: An insectoid nomad with four arms. They are masters of the desert and waste.

sea_serpent.name: Sea Serpent
sea_serpent.desc: A smaller cousin of the great dragons. It haunts the coastal waters and river mouths.

blind_ravager.name: Blind Ravager
blind_ravager.desc: A blind, stone-skinned humanoid from the deep underground. It senses vibrations with uncanny accuracy.

deep_spawn.name: Deep Spawn
deep_spawn.desc: A warped, aquatic slave of the aboleths. It is a creature of pure, mindless servitude.

troglodyte.name: Troglodyte
troglodyte.desc: A lizard-like subterranean dweller. Its stench is so foul it can weaken the strongest warriors.

great_roc.name: Great Roc
great_roc.desc: A giant bird of prey that can snatch up a horse in its talons. Its wings create gale-force gusts.

gargoyle.name: Gargoyle
gargoyle.desc: Stone that moves. Aeridor ruins are full of them. They wait until you touch something.

bloom_maw.name: Bloom Maw
bloom_maw.desc: A massive carnivorous plant with thrashing vine-arms. Its breath causes nausea at ten feet.

lamia.name: Lamia
lamia.desc: A serpent-woman. Her song carries across the Whisperwood. It makes you want to stand still.

golem.name: Stone Golem
golem.desc: A construct of animated Aeridorian stone. Slow. Each step cracks the ground. Magic animates it.

ruin_chimera.name: Ruin Chimera
ruin_chimera.desc: A lion's body, goat head, serpent tail. Three creatures in one bad mood.

dark_wizard.name: Dark Wizard
dark_wizard.desc: A robed figure with hands that emit cold light. Probably human once. Debatable now.

werewolf.name: Werewolf
werewolf.desc: Not a monster by daylight. At night, something else entirely. The Whisperwood makes it worse.

wyvern.name: Wyvern
wyvern.desc: A two-legged dragon. Breathes lightning. Territorial. Not fully grown. Worse when cornered.

hollow_snatcher.name: Hollow Snatcher
hollow_snatcher.desc: A floating thing with too many eyes. It doesn't kill — it takes. Where it takes things is unclear.

soldier.name: Aeridorian Soldier
soldier.desc: A warrior animated by Aeridorian resonance. It still holds formation. It still remembers orders.

manticore.name: Manticore
manticore.desc: Lion body, human face, scorpion tail. It's smart enough to know it's terrifying.

bog_claw.name: Bog Claw
bog_claw.desc: An enormous crustacean that crawled up from underground. Its shell deflects most blades.

cinder_fiend.name: Cinder Fiend
cinder_fiend.desc: A small devil-creature. Not powerful. Very fast. Very loud. Calls things you don't want called.

whispering_urn.name: Whispering Urn
whispering_urn.desc: An animated pot that cannot be damaged by ordinary means. If you figure it out, you're rich.

mirror_adept.name: Mirror Adept
mirror_adept.desc: A caster with a reflective field. Turns spells back on the caster. Physical attacks still work.

treant.name: Treant
treant.desc: A walking tree. Patient beyond measure. It was here before the Whisperwood had a name.

wind_serpent.name: Wind Serpent
wind_serpent.desc: A serpent that rides updrafts. It attacks on the dive, vanishing before you can swing back.

earth_bear.name: Earth Bear
earth_bear.desc: A massive brown bear with stone-encrusted paws. The Whisperwood deep produces them occasionally.

alchemist.name: Rogue Alchemist
alchemist.desc: A former scholar who went too deep into the ruins. Throws volatile compounds. Unpredictable.

hill_gigas.name: Hill Gigas
hill_gigas.desc: A giant the height of two men. Throws boulders. Not smart enough to aim well, but doesn't need to be.

fire_gigas.name: Fire Gigas
fire_gigas.desc: A giant wreathed in flame. The ground chars where it walks. Its fists ignite on impact.

griffon.name: Griffon
griffon.desc: Eagle head, lion body. Nests on the ruins' highest spires. Protective of territory and young.

thought_reaver.name: Thought Reaver
thought_reaver.desc: A tentacle-faced horror that feeds on thoughts. You forget what you were fighting mid-swing.

naga.name: Naga
naga.desc: A serpent-bodied woman with a trident and ancient spite. Guards waterways and drowned places.

ogre.name: Ogre
ogre.desc: A hulking brute with a tree trunk for a weapon. Stupid and strong in exactly that order.

spectre.name: Spectre
spectre.desc: A ghost that has given up on mourning and moved on to malice. Drains warmth from the air.

troll.name: Troll
troll.desc: A gangly, grey-skinned brute that regenerates. You have to burn the pieces or they crawl back together.

dullahan.name: Dullahan
dullahan.desc: A headless knight on a headless horse. Carries its skull under one arm. The skull watches you.

sand_angler.name: Sand Angler
sand_angler.desc: Buries itself in the road dust and waits. Its mandibles close faster than you can react.

gelatinous_cube.name: Gelatinous Cube
gelatinous_cube.desc: A transparent cube of acid and hunger. It moves silent and slow, digesting everything it touches.

nightmare.name: Nightmare
nightmare.desc: An undead horse wreathed in dark flames. It leaves scorched hoofprints and the smell of ozone.

gorgon.name: Gorgon
gorgon.desc: A scale-covered bull with a breath that turns creatures to stone. Its hide is as hard as iron.

mimic.name: Mimic
mimic.desc: A creature that takes the form of inanimate objects. Its tongue is sticky and its teeth are numerous.

air_elemental.name: Air Elemental
air_elemental.desc: A living whirlwind. It strikes with the force of a hurricane and vanishes as quickly as it appears.

bulette.name: Bulette
bulette.desc: The 'land shark'. It burrows through the earth and leaps out to consume its prey in a single bite.

hook_beast.name: Hook Beast
hook_beast.desc: An avian-insectoid hybrid that climbs cave walls with massive, hooked claws. It communicates through clicks.

tunnel_hulk.name: Tunnel Hulk
tunnel_hulk.desc: A massive, ape-like insectoid with eyes that can confuse the mind. It is a master of subterranean ambush.

owlbear.name: Owlbear
owlbear.desc: A feathered horror — part owl, part bear, all fury. It charges through undergrowth without slowing.

phase_panther.name: Phase Panther
phase_panther.desc: A six-legged panther that bends light around itself. It's never quite where it appears to be.

web_tender.name: Web Tender
web_tender.desc: A spider-like humanoid that weaves traps of web and malice. Found near Whisperwood nests.

chimera_beast.name: Chimera Beast
chimera_beast.desc: Three heads, three breaths, one bad attitude. The goat head is the most dangerous — it bites.

spire_seraph.name: Spire Seraph
spire_seraph.desc: A radiant winged warrior from a forgotten age. She guards something that no longer exists.

hollow_pilgrim.name: Hollow Pilgrim
hollow_pilgrim.desc: Small. Robed. Carries a lantern and a chef's knife. Moves with terrible patience. Its grudge is older than Oakhaven.

rot_maw.name: Rot Maw
rot_maw.desc: A writhing mass of tentacles and mouths. Its breath alone has ended parties. Do not engage at close range.

dark_knight.name: Dark Knight
dark_knight.desc: A fallen warrior animated by dark resonance. Fights with ruthless efficiency. Has no interest in mercy.

iron_giant.name: Iron Giant
iron_giant.desc: An armored colossus wielding a greatsword. Each strike shakes the ground. It does not pursue. It does not need to.

crag_raptor.name: Crag Raptor
crag_raptor.desc: A massive bird of prey. Wingspan blocks the sun. Hunts from above and stoops at killing speed.

arcane_drake.name: Arcane Drake
arcane_drake.desc: A juvenile dragon that has absorbed residual Aeridorian resonance. Its breath has crystalline properties.

elder_raptor.name: Elder Raptor
elder_raptor.desc: An ancient predator, resurrected by ruin-magic. Not adapted to this era. Angrier for it.

titan.name: Titan
titan.desc: A creature of pure geological force. The ground shakes when it breathes. It is not attacking you — it simply cannot feel you.

shadow_dancer.name: Shadow Dancer
shadow_dancer.desc: A figure made of concentrated shadow. Moves through walls. Strikes from angles that shouldn't exist.

killer_mantis.name: Killer Mantis
killer_mantis.desc: An insect the size of a horse. Its foreclaws are serrated. It waits in the deep undergrowth for exactly as long as necessary.

skull_knight.name: Skull Knight
skull_knight.desc: Full plate, no occupant. An animated suit of Aeridorian armor that remembers war.

minotaur.name: Minotaur
minotaur.desc: A bull-headed warrior from deep in the ruins. Powerful, furious, and surprisingly tactical.

nachtmahr.name: Nachtmahr
nachtmahr.desc: A nightmare given form. It appears at the edge of vision, then closer, then too close. Feeds on fear.

crystelle.name: Crystelle
crystelle.desc: An Aeridorian crystalline construct still running its original directives. Those directives involve harm.

gloom_ray.name: Gloom Ray
gloom_ray.desc: A two-beaked flying creature the color of storm clouds. Discharges lightning passively.

living_folio.name: The Living Folio
living_folio.desc: Something went wrong. Or right. It's unclear. It falls over if you look at it firmly.

veiled_stalker.name: Veiled Stalker
veiled_stalker.desc: One of the Veiled — the pale race — but gone wrong. Or gone further. It hunts other Veiled now.

soil_ghoul.name: Soil Ghoul
soil_ghoul.desc: Born from the Broken Mire. The swamp has given it mass and patience and very little else.

drake.name: Drake
drake.desc: A wingless dragon. What it lacks in flight it makes up for in sheer armored mass and fire breath.

medusa.name: Medusa
medusa.desc: A woman with snakes for hair and a gaze that turns flesh to stone. Don't look at her face.

ghast.name: Ghast
ghast.desc: A ghoul that has fed enough to evolve. Paralyzing touch, rotting stench, and a hunger that never ends.

wight.name: Wight
wight.desc: An undead lord that drains life with a touch. Where it walks, plants wither and animals flee.

wyrm.name: Wyrm
wyrm.desc: An adolescent dragon. Already dangerous. In a century it will be devastating. Best dealt with now.

spectral_knight.name: Spectral Knight
spectral_knight.desc: An Aeridorian champion who refused death. Fights with skill perfected over a thousand years of undeath.

clay_golem.name: Clay Golem
clay_golem.desc: Animated clay given purpose by ancient wards. Slow but utterly relentless. Absorbs blunt damage.

rend_claw.name: Rend Claw
rend_claw.desc: A massive crustacean with claws that can sever a horse. Found in deep cave systems beneath the ruins.

gaze_tyrant.name: Gaze Tyrant
gaze_tyrant.desc: A floating orb of eyes and madness. Each eye stalk can fire a different deadly ray.

thought_reaver_elder.name: Elder Thought Reaver
thought_reaver_elder.desc: An thought-reaver master of psionics. It hungers for brains and enslaves the wills of the weak.

rakshasa.name: Rakshasa
rakshasa.desc: A tiger-headed fiend and master of illusion. Its hands are backwards, and its heart is pure malice.

iron_colossus.name: Iron Colossus
iron_colossus.desc: A massive, plate-armored golem with a cleaver the size of a man. It exists only to crush.

burrow_wurm.name: Burrow Wurm
burrow_wurm.desc: A worm so large it can swallow whole wagons. It moves with a crushing weight through the deep forest.

bone_devil.name: Bone Devil
bone_devil.desc: A skeletal fiend with a stinging tail. It is a merciless enforcer of hell's laws.

dead_gaze_tyrant.name: Dead Gaze Tyrant
dead_gaze_tyrant.desc: An undead gaze tyrant. Its eye stalks glow with a sickly red light, and its gaze is the very chill of the grave.

drider.name: Drider
drider.desc: A drow transformed into a half-spider monstrosity. It is a cursed weaver of webs and shadow.

storm_giant.name: Storm Giant
storm_giant.desc: A titan of the heights. It commands the lightning and the thunder with a word.

balor.name: Balor
balor.desc: A towering demon of fire and shadow. It wields a flaming sword and a multi-tailed whip of lightning.

glabrezu.name: Glabrezu
glabrezu.desc: A demon that tempts with power and wealth, only to crush its victims with its massive claws.

hezrou.name: Hezrou
hezrou.desc: A toad-like demon of filth and disease. Its presence is an affront to the senses.

marilith.name: Marilith
marilith.desc: A six-armed serpent demon. She is a master of the blade, striking with a whirlwind of steel.

vrock.name: Vrock
vrock.desc: A vulture-headed demon of greed. Its screech can stun those who witness its horrific dance.

dire_wolf.name: Dire Wolf
dire_wolf.desc: A wolf the size of a horse. Matted black fur, yellow eyes, and a jaw that can snap bone. Hunts the deep Whisperwood alone. Not the pack animal its smaller cousins are.

wraith.name: Wraith
wraith.desc: A shadow given hunger. It passes through walls and armor alike. Cold radiates from it in waves. What it touches, it drains.

stone_golem.name: Greater Stone Golem
stone_golem.desc: An Aeridorian war construct carved from resonance-hardened granite. Twice the size of the common golem. Each fist strike sends shockwaves through the floor.

clockwork_guard.name: Clockwork Guard
clockwork_guard.desc: An Aeridorian automaton still running on ancient gears and resonance. Its halberd arm never tires. Its patrol route hasn't changed in a thousand years.

behemoth.name: Behemoth
behemoth.desc: A massive horned beast the size of a wagon. Its charge levels walls. It is not the biggest thing in the Whisperwood.

dragon.name: Ancient Dragon
dragon.desc: A scaled leviathan older than the ruins. Fire breath. Tail crushes steel. It finds you mildly interesting.

lich.name: Lich
lich.desc: An undead sorcerer of immense age. Commands the dead as an afterthought. Its touch drains life in a way that isn't metaphorical.

bastion_tortoise.name: Bastion Tortoise
bastion_tortoise.desc: A mountain-sized tortoise. Shell is effectively impenetrable. Patient. Ancient. Very hard to damage and in no hurry.

the_last_engine.name: The Last Engine
the_last_engine.desc: A weapon of unknown origin. No history. No motive. No language. It simply destroys. Nobody knows who built it or why.

deepwater_wyrm.name: Deepwater Wyrm
deepwater_wyrm.desc: A divine dragon. It doesn't breathe fire — it breathes something older. Looking directly at it is difficult.

accursed_tree.name: The Accursed Tree
accursed_tree.desc: A massive dead tree at the heart of the deep Whisperwood. It moves. Something is inside it. Something sealed there.

azure_savant.name: Azure Savant
azure_savant.desc: A mage who absorbed too many spells and stopped being a person. Uses everything it has seen against you.

dread_sigil.name: Dread Sigil
dread_sigil.desc: Floats. Surrounded by four barrier shields. Fears nothing but death, which it causes constantly.

wandering_blademaster.name: The Wandering Blademaster
wandering_blademaster.desc: A wandering warrior with eight arms, each carrying a different weapon. Only one of them is real. He doesn't know which.

apocalypse.name: Apocalypse
apocalypse.desc: It emerged from the Aeridor ruins during a resonance event. It is what happens when Aeridorian magic goes completely wrong.

great_behemoth.name: Great Behemoth
great_behemoth.desc: The behemoth you fought before was young. This one is not.

shadow_lich.name: Shadow Lich
shadow_lich.desc: A lich that has dissolved its physical form entirely. You cannot stab it. You can only outlast its patience.

needle_sprite.name: Needle Sprite
needle_sprite.desc: A towering spiny cactus creature. Its needles fire faster than you can blink. Getting close is the hard part.

antlion.name: Sand Worm
antlion.desc: An enormous burrowing predator. The ground gives way and then there is sand and darkness and teeth.

hungering_maw.name: The Hungering Maw
hungering_maw.desc: A gravity entity. Vast, slow, and possessing a mouth like a collapsed star. It draws things in.

king_behemoth.name: King Behemoth
king_behemoth.desc: The apex predator. Horns like battering rams, hide like castle walls. Everything else is prey.

red_dragon.name: Red Dragon
red_dragon.desc: A mature dragon with scales the color of cooling lava. Its fire breath melts stone.

frost_dragon.name: Frost Dragon
frost_dragon.desc: A dragon of ice and wind. Its breath freezes blood in the veins. Nests in the highest peaks.

iron_golem.name: Iron Golem
iron_golem.desc: An Aeridorian war machine of solid iron. Immune to most magic. Hits like a collapsing bridge.

vampire_lord.name: Vampire Lord
vampire_lord.desc: An ancient undead aristocrat. Charms, drains, and vanishes. Has been planning this encounter for decades.

hydra.name: Hydra
hydra.desc: A multi-headed serpent. Cut one head off and two grow back. Fire is the answer, if you can get close enough.

dark_rider.name: Dark Rider
dark_rider.desc: A horseman in black plate that appears on the trade road at midnight. Those who flee say his lance never misses.

avatar_of_the_hoard_mother.name: Avatar of the Hoard Mother
avatar_of_the_hoard_mother.desc: A five-headed dragon aspect. Each head breathes a different form of elemental destruction.

echo_of_the_tyrant.name: Echo of the Dragon-Tyrant
echo_of_the_tyrant.desc: A fragment of the elder dragon planeswalker. Even a shadow of his brilliance is enough to shatter worlds.

dragon_sovereign.name: The Dragon Sovereign
dragon_sovereign.desc: The King of Dragons. His 'Megaflare' is the stuff of legends and nightmares.

cinderpeak_dragon.name: Cinderpeak Dragon
cinderpeak_dragon.desc: The master of the Shiv mountains. Its breath is an endless torrent of fire.

death_knight.name: Death Knight
death_knight.desc: A fallen paladin that has traded its soul for eternal undeath and unholy power.

ancient_red_dragon.name: Ancient Red Dragon
ancient_red_dragon.desc: The ultimate incarnation of greed and fire. Its mere presence can scorch the earth for miles.

tarrasque.name: The Tarrasque
tarrasque.desc: A legendary engine of pure destruction. It does not think; it only consumes and destroys.

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.desc: The terror of the deep. Its tentacles can drag the largest ships to a watery grave.

echo_of_the_twin_maw.name: Echo of the Twin-Maw
echo_of_the_twin_maw.desc: The Prince of Demons. His two heads, Aameul and Hethradiah, are locked in eternal conflict.

aspect_of_the_undying_prince.name: Aspect of the Undying Prince
aspect_of_the_undying_prince.desc: The Demon Prince of Undeath. He wields a skull-tipped wand that can extinguish life with a touch.

avatar_of_the_dark_prince.name: Avatar of the Dark Prince
avatar_of_the_dark_prince.desc: The Dark Prince of Pleasure. He is a master of seduction and strategic cruelty.

shadow_of_the_faceless_ooze.name: Shadow of the Faceless Ooze
shadow_of_the_faceless_ooze.desc: The Faceless Lord. A bubbling mass of slime and eyes that dissolves everything it touches.

elder_treant.name: Elder Treant
elder_treant.desc: The oldest tree in the Whisperwood. It was a person once, in the Aeridor era. It has not forgotten that either.

pilgrim_king.name: The Pilgrim King
pilgrim_king.desc: You killed enough hollow pilgrims that the king noticed. It is very, very slow. You will not be able to run forever.

the_eyeless_lich_god.name: The Eyeless Lich-God
the_eyeless_lich_god.desc: The god of secrets and undeath. He watches from the hollow heart of existence.

the_tomb_sovereign.name: The Tomb Sovereign
the_tomb_sovereign.desc: A planes-hopping lich who builds tombs for the sole purpose of harvesting souls.

the_unmaking.name: The Unmaking
the_unmaking.desc: The source of all ruin. A cycle of hatred and power that spans across time.

the_starless_one.name: The Starless One
the_starless_one.desc: The embodiment of pure spite. It does not exist, yet its hatred is absolute.

the_ashen_knight_lord.name: The Ashen Knight-Lord
the_ashen_knight_lord.desc: The Knight of the Rose, now a Death Knight. His word is death, and his touch is the grave.

the_sealed_one.name: The Sealed One
the_sealed_one.desc: A tree born of ancient malice. He seeks to return all to the Void.

deepwater_sovereign.name: The Deepwater Sovereign
deepwater_sovereign.desc: A dragon from the Rift. He is the master of elemental devastation and cosmic power.

the_last_engine_unbound.name: The Last Engine, Unbound
the_last_engine_unbound.desc: An ancient machine of war. its defense is impenetrable, and its fire is absolute.

the_laughing_ascendant.name: The Laughing Ascendant
the_laughing_ascendant.desc: A mad court mage who has stolen the power of gods. He laughs as the world burns.

aeridorian_guardian.name: Aeridorian Guardian
aeridorian_guardian.desc: The final defense construct of Aeridor. It has been waiting in the deepest vault for a thousand years. It is fully operational.

the_hooded_figure.name: The Hooded Figure
the_hooded_figure.desc: The man from the corner of the Stone Hearth. He is not what he appeared to be. He has not appeared to be anything for a very long time.

darek_shadow_bound.name: Darek Shadow-Bound
darek_shadow_bound.desc: A legendary vault infiltrator and master thief of the Iron Magpies clad in muffled midnight silk, armed with poisoned stilettos and bulging sacks of stolen Gold.

garrett_vault_creeper.name: Garrett the Vault-Creeper
garrett_vault_creeper.desc: A wiry, ceiling-crawling lockpicker from the Iron Magpies, draped in dark oilskin and bristling with skeleton keys and smoke bombs.

felix_ghost_hand.name: Felix "Ghost-Hand" Pryce
felix_ghost_hand.desc: The infamous phantom cutpurse of the Iron Magpies, moving soundlessly through vault shadows with enchanted picks and twin concealed daggers.

whisperwood_heart.name: Heart of the Whisperwood
whisperwood_heart.desc: The Whisperwood is not a forest. It is one organism. This is its center. This is what swallowed Aeridor.

elara_turned.name: Elder Elara (Turned)
elara_turned.desc: Something has been inside her for a long time. The weight she carries. The warnings she wouldn't give. Now you know why.

the_count_of_shadows.name: The Count of Shadows
the_count_of_shadows.desc: A vampire lord older than Oakhaven itself. He ruled a kingdom once. Now he rules only the dark. His sword arm has not dulled in centuries.

emissary_of_the_web_queen.name: Emissary of the Web Queen
emissary_of_the_web_queen.desc: An avatar of the Spider Queen, draped in living silk. Eight eyes regard you from beneath a crown of chitin. The webs here are older than the trees.

the_dracolich.name: The Dracolich
the_dracolich.desc: A dragon that chose undeath over oblivion. Its bones are fused with Aeridorian crystal. Its breath is necrotic frost. It remembers everything.

the_elder_mind.name: The Elder Mind
the_elder_mind.desc: The collective consciousness of an thought-reaver colony, pulsing in a pool of brine beneath the ruins. It has been thinking about you for a very long time.

rakthar_pit_lord.name: Rak'thar, Pit Lord
rakthar_pit_lord.desc: An archdevil summoned through an Aeridorian gate that was never meant to open. He is patient, armored in contract-forged iron, and he has already taken your measure.

gaze_sovereign.name: The Gaze Sovereign
gaze_sovereign.desc: A floating sphere of hate with a central eye that unmakes magic and a crown of stalks that each carry death in a different flavor. It believes it is the only real thing in the room.

echo_of_the_burning_heart.name: Echo of the Burning Heart
echo_of_the_burning_heart.desc: The resonant memory of an ancient wyrm, crystallized in Aeridorian stone. It is not alive. It does not need to be. Its fire is real enough.

the_drowned_dreamer.name: The Drowned Dreamer
the_drowned_dreamer.desc: An aquatic horror from before the age of mortals. It sleeps beneath the deepest ruins and dreams of a time when it ruled everything. Its dreams are contagious.

bone_colossus.name: The Bone Colossus
bone_colossus.desc: An undead construct assembled from the remains of a thousand soldiers. It stands three stories tall and its fists are siege weapons. The Whisperwood built it from what it swallowed.

malachar_the_undying.name: Malachar the Undying
malachar_the_undying.desc: Aethelgard's last archmage. He did not die when Aeridor fell — he refused. His phylactery is somewhere in the ruins, and he has had centuries to prepare for visitors.

whisperwood_titan.name: The Whisperwood Titan
whisperwood_titan.desc: A colossus of root and stone that stirs when the forest is deeply threatened. It moves like an earthquake and speaks in the groaning of a thousand trees bending at once.

vorath_chain_devil.name: Vorath, the Chain Devil
vorath_chain_devil.desc: A devil that binds souls with chains forged from broken promises. Each link was a person once. He offers deals in a voice like dragging iron across stone.

tunnel_crawler.name: Tunnel Crawler
tunnel_crawler.desc: A blind, pale centipede the size of a warhorse. It navigates by tasting the vibrations of your footsteps.

abandoned_miner_ghoul.name: Abandoned Miner Ghoul
abandoned_miner_ghoul.desc: It still wears the Ironclad Guild tabard, though it is soaked in centuries of grime. Its pickaxe is fused to its hand.

cave_troll.name: Cave Troll
cave_troll.desc: A hulking mass of muscle and fungus. It regenerates in the dark and hates the light of your lantern.

the_first_miner.name: The First Miner
the_first_miner.desc: He struck the first stone when the mine was opened. He never left. His eyes are solid white crystals.

bone_weaver_spider.name: Bone Weaver Spider
bone_weaver_spider.desc: It uses femurs and ribcages to anchor its webs. The silk is as hard as steel wire.

crypt_stalker.name: Crypt Stalker
crypt_stalker.desc: A four-legged undead horror that runs silently along the ceiling, waiting to drop on unsuspecting delvers.

ossuary_golem.name: Ossuary Golem
ossuary_golem.desc: A construct built entirely from skulls and mortared with dried blood. It moans with a hundred voices when struck.

the_unburied_king.name: The Unburied King
the_unburied_king.desc: He ruled these catacombs before the mountain was ever mined. He sits on a throne of spinal cords, wielding a femur like a scepter.

forge_fire_elemental.name: Forge Fire Elemental
forge_fire_elemental.desc: A living pillar of white-hot plasma that escaped the ancient furnaces. The air blisters your skin just standing near it.

slag_horror.name: Slag Horror
slag_horror.desc: A gelatinous mass of molten metal and discarded impurities. It burns through armor and flesh with equal ease.

iron_sentinel.name: Iron Sentinel
iron_sentinel.desc: A towering construct of dark iron, programmed a thousand years ago to protect the forge from intruders. It still remembers its orders.

the_living_forge.name: The Living Forge
the_living_forge.desc: The forge itself came alive, its bellows breathing and its hammers swinging on their own. It wants to reforge you into a sword.

void_stalker.name: Void Stalker
void_stalker.desc: A creature from the space between stars. It slips through the dark like smoke, its claws tearing reality itself.

abyssal_crawler.name: Abyssal Crawler
abyssal_crawler.desc: An armored behemoth adapted to the crushing pressure of the deep dark. Its shell is nearly impenetrable.

thought_reaver_outcast.name: Thought Reaver Outcast
thought_reaver_outcast.desc: An thought-reaver severed from the Elder Mind, wandering the deep alone. Its psychic blasts are fueled by pure desperation.

the_deep_watcher.name: The Deep Watcher
the_deep_watcher.desc: A massive, unblinking eye floating in the center of the void. To look directly at it is to invite madness into your mind.

crystal_golem.name: Crystal Golem
crystal_golem.desc: Constructed from pure Aeridorian resonance crystals. Its strikes vibrate with a frequency that shatters bone instantly.

resonance_wraith.name: Resonance Wraith
resonance_wraith.desc: An ethereal entity formed from the mountain's ambient magical energy. It phases through attacks and sings a song of destruction.

core_guardian.name: Core Guardian
core_guardian.desc: A flawless, monolithic entity stationed just above the mountain's heart. Its armor is seamless, its weapons are absolute.

the_mountain_heart.name: The Mountain Heart
the_mountain_heart.desc: The sentient core of the Spine of the World. It does not speak, it does not move. It simply erases those who dare to approach it.

pit_viper.name: Pit Viper
pit_viper.desc: A venomous serpent that nests in collapsed shafts. Its heat pits detect warm-blooded prey in total darkness.

rubble_golem.name: Rubble Golem
rubble_golem.desc: Loose stones animated by residual Aeridorian energy. It reassembles itself from the walls when disturbed.

gas_spore.name: Gas Spore
gas_spore.desc: A floating fungal sphere that detonates on contact. The miners called them 'pocket deaths.'

ore_mimic.name: Ore Mimic
ore_mimic.desc: It looks exactly like a vein of precious ore until you swing your pickaxe. Then it swings back.

tunnel_wyrm.name: Tunnel Wyrm
tunnel_wyrm.desc: A juvenile drake that burrowed too deep and adapted. Eyeless, earless, and entirely guided by tremorsense.

bone_amalgam.name: Bone Amalgam
bone_amalgam.desc: Dozens of skeletons fused into a single shambling mass. It has too many arms and not enough coordination, but sheer volume compensates.

corpse_lantern.name: Corpse Lantern
corpse_lantern.desc: A floating skull wreathed in sickly green flame. It lures the unwary deeper into the warrens with its hypnotic glow.

charnel_crawler.name: Charnel Crawler
charnel_crawler.desc: A centipede-like horror that feeds on grave dust and calcified marrow. Its mandibles secrete a paralytic toxin.

burial_mimic.name: Burial Mimic
burial_mimic.desc: It disguises itself as a sarcophagus. When you open the lid, the lid opens you.

cairn_wight.name: Cairn Wight
cairn_wight.desc: An ancient warrior entombed standing upright. It draws its sword with the practiced ease of someone who has been rehearsing for centuries.

crucible_ooze.name: Crucible Ooze
crucible_ooze.desc: Molten metal waste that achieved a rudimentary sentience. It absorbs weapons and grows stronger with each meal.

bellows_construct.name: Bellows Construct
bellows_construct.desc: An Aeridorian maintenance unit with oversized pneumatic arms. Its pressure valves scream when it charges.

anvil_golem.name: Anvil Golem
anvil_golem.desc: Built from a single massive anvil and animated by forge-magic. Every step shakes the floor. Every fist reshapes the architecture.

chain_horror.name: Chain Horror
chain_horror.desc: Animated chains from the forge's hoisting apparatus. They lash out with razor links and drag victims into the machinery.

furnace_wight.name: Furnace Wight
furnace_wight.desc: A forge worker who died at their station. The furnace heat preserved the body perfectly. The resentment preserved the soul.

void_lamprey.name: Void Lamprey
void_lamprey.desc: An eel-like creature that swims through the spaces between dimensions. Its bite leaves wounds that never fully close.

psychic_leech.name: Psychic Leech
psychic_leech.desc: A brain-shaped parasite that feeds on conscious thought. Proximity causes nosebleeds and fragmented memories.

null_wraith.name: Null Wraith
null_wraith.desc: The ghost of something that was never alive. It exists as an absence — a hole in reality that moves with deliberate malice.

thought_eater.name: Thought Eater
thought_eater.desc: An ethereal predator that consumes ideas. Survivors of its attacks describe a permanent, specific gap in their knowledge.

depth_crawler.name: Depth Crawler
depth_crawler.desc: An armored arthropod the size of a horse, adapted to crushing pressure. It clicks its mandibles in a pattern that sounds like counting.

resonance_golem.name: Resonance Golem
resonance_golem.desc: A towering construct of pure crystallized resonance. It hums at a frequency that liquefies unprotected organs.

vessel_husk.name: Vessel Husk
vessel_husk.desc: The dried remains of a previous Resonance Vessel. Elara was not the first. This one still remembers its purpose.

core_parasite.name: Core Parasite
core_parasite.desc: A worm-like entity that burrows through the mountain's nervous system. It is both tumor and antibody.

mountain_nerve.name: Mountain Nerve
mountain_nerve.desc: A tendril of the mountain's living infrastructure, severed and hostile. It lashes out with bioelectric pulses.

tithe_collector.name: Tithe Collector
tithe_collector.desc: An Aeridorian construct tasked with gathering organic material for the mountain's core. It considers you an overdue payment.

blind_cave_leech.name: Blind Cave Leech
blind_cave_leech.desc: It drops from the cavern ceiling without a sound, seeking the warmth of blood. It has no eyes, only hunger.

rust_lung_miner.name: Rust-Lung Miner
rust_lung_miner.desc: A former worker of the deep tunnels. Its lungs gave out years ago, replaced by a wet, rattling cough and an endless hostility toward the living.

chittering_skitterer.name: Chittering Skitterer
chittering_skitterer.desc: A multi-legged vermin with a hard carapace. It moves erratically, always attempting to flank its prey in the dark.

iron_blight_bat.name: Iron-Blight Bat
iron_blight_bat.desc: Oversized and mutated by the ores of the mountain. Its bite leaves behind jagged flakes of toxic rust.

subterranean_prowler.name: Subterranean Prowler
subterranean_prowler.desc: A sleek, pale predator adapted to complete darkness. It tracks prey by the vibrations of their heartbeat.

foremans_enforcer.name: Foreman's Enforcer
foremans_enforcer.desc: Once tasked with keeping the miners in line, now tasked with keeping intruders out. It wields a massive, blood-stained pickaxe.

marrow_hound.name: Marrow Hound
marrow_hound.desc: A feral canine assembled from mismatched bones. It doesn't bark; it only clatters as it charges.

crypt_warden.name: Crypt Warden
crypt_warden.desc: A skeletal guardian adorned in rusted armor. Its eye sockets burn with a pale, cold flame.

whispering_skull_swarm.name: Whispering Skull-Swarm
whispering_skull_swarm.desc: A dozen animated skulls orbiting each other, chattering incessantly. The noise is disorienting and maddening.

ash_wraith.name: Ash Wraith
ash_wraith.desc: The bitter remains of a cremated soul. It phases through solid bone, leaving a trail of choking grey dust.

ossified_terror.name: Ossified Terror
ossified_terror.desc: A hulking amalgamation of ribcages and femurs woven together by dark magic. It crushes everything in its path.

entombed_scholar.name: Entombed Scholar
entombed_scholar.desc: It studied the dark resonance of these catacombs until it became part of them. It casts spells of pure, focused despair.

slag_crawler_spine.name: Slag-Crawler
slag_crawler_spine.desc: A crustacean-like entity with a shell made of hardened slag. It spits globs of superheated metal.

ignited_sentinel.name: Ignited Sentinel
ignited_sentinel.desc: An Aeridorian construct permanently set on fire. The heat radiating from it warps the air and scorches the ground.

smoldering_ash_walker.name: Smoldering Ash-Walker
smoldering_ash_walker.desc: A humanoid figure composed entirely of burning embers. Its footsteps leave permanent scorch marks.

molten_slime.name: Molten Slime
molten_slime.desc: A blob of liquid fire that absorbed industrial runoff. Touching it is a very bad idea.

brass_plated_hound.name: Brass-Plated Hound
brass_plated_hound.desc: A mechanical beast driven by an internal furnace. It vents steam when angry, which is always.

forge_fire_wisp.name: Forge-Fire Wisp
forge_fire_wisp.desc: A concentrated spark of Aeridorian forge-magic. Extremely fragile, but capable of incinerating a heavily armored knight.

void_touched_weaver.name: Void-Touched Weaver
void_touched_weaver.desc: A massive arachnid corrupted by the deep resonance. Its webs don't just trap the body; they trap the mind.

deep_stalker.name: Deep Stalker
deep_stalker.desc: Tall, gangly, and utterly silent. You only know it's there when you feel its cold breath on your neck.

abyssal_leech_spine.name: Abyssal Leech
abyssal_leech_spine.desc: A monstrous annelid that thrives in the absolute dark. Its bite drains both blood and magical energy.

eyeless_horror.name: Eyeless Horror
eyeless_horror.desc: A hulking mass of flesh and teeth. It relies entirely on echolocation, shrieking constantly to map its surroundings.

resonance_warped_troll.name: Resonance-Warped Troll
resonance_warped_troll.desc: A cave troll that wandered too deep. Crystals jut from its skin, granting it terrible magical resistance but driving it insane.

the_lurking_shadow.name: The Lurking Shadow
the_lurking_shadow.desc: A predator made of pure darkness. It snuffs out torches merely by existing near them.

pulse_walker.name: Pulse-Walker
pulse_walker.desc: An entity animated by the heartbeat of the mountain. Its attacks strike in perfect rhythm with the pulsing walls.

crystalline_abomination.name: Crystalline Abomination
crystalline_abomination.desc: A jagged horror of pure resonance crystal. It shatters weapons that strike it and hums with a deafening frequency.

flesh_forged_construct.name: Flesh-Forged Construct
flesh_forged_construct.desc: Aeridorian machinery fused with organic matter. The horrible culmination of the mountain's long digestion.

the_mountains_white_blood.name: The Mountain's White Blood
the_mountains_white_blood.desc: A massive, rolling wave of corrosive white fluid that functions as the mountain's immune response.

aeridorian_echo.name: Aeridorian Echo
aeridorian_echo.desc: A ghostly projection of a long-dead Aeridorian geomancer. It wields ancient, forgotten magic with perfect precision.

core_warped_behemoth.name: Core-Warped Behemoth
core_warped_behemoth.desc: A legendary beast entirely consumed and puppeteered by the mountain's core. Its eyes are empty white crystals.

black_dragon.name: Black Dragon
black_dragon.desc: Acid breath. Nests in places of long decay. The Bone Warrens suit it perfectly. Its scales have the flat darkness of things that have never seen sun.

blue_dragon.name: Blue Dragon
blue_dragon.desc: Lightning breath drawn to the resonance conducting through ancient bone. It found the Warrens and decided to stay. The lightning has been doing interesting things to the carvings.

green_dragon.name: Green Dragon
green_dragon.desc: Poison breath. Coils through the burial alcoves. The poison has preserved some things that would otherwise have rotted. It considers this an artistic contribution.

white_dragon.name: White Dragon
white_dragon.desc: Cold breath. The least intelligent of the chromatics, but cold this far underground serves a different purpose than on a mountaintop. The Warrens have a cryogenic quality to them now.

ancient_black_dragon.name: Ancient Black Dragon
ancient_black_dragon.desc: Old enough that its acid has eaten through the Forge's original stonework. The Guild stumbled onto its territory and didn't understand why the walls were dissolving.

ancient_blue_dragon.name: Ancient Blue Dragon
ancient_blue_dragon.desc: Its lightning storms precede it by two floors. The Aeridorian equipment here hasn't been properly grounded in six centuries. This was not a problem until recently.

ancient_green_dragon.name: Ancient Green Dragon
ancient_green_dragon.desc: Its poison has achieved a biological complexity that the Aeridorian alchemists would have studied with great interest. They are not available for comment.

ancient_white_dragon.name: Ancient White Dragon
ancient_white_dragon.desc: Ancient and cold and patient. The forge zone's warmth ends at its floor. Below it, everything is ice-rimed. Above it, the forge's heat reasserts. The boundary is exact.

gold_dragon.name: Gold Dragon
gold_dragon.desc: Hoarding the Forge's unclaimed output. It has been down here since before the Guild, accumulating Aeridorian alloys it cannot use and does not understand. It will not share.

silver_dragon.name: Silver Dragon
silver_dragon.desc: Assigned by Aeridor to guard the forge approaches. The assignment is 600 years overdue for review. It is still doing it. Duty, in its estimation, does not expire.

bronze_dragon.name: Bronze Dragon
bronze_dragon.desc: The oldest of the forge's metallic guardians. Its breath carries repulsion-force derived from old storm-binding. It was here before the forge. It is not clear what it was guarding before.

copper_dragon.name: Copper Dragon
copper_dragon.desc: The most unpredictable. Its acid-breath slows targets and it will absolutely attempt to negotiate mid-combat. The negotiation is not in good faith. The acid is.

brass_dragon.name: Brass Dragon
brass_dragon.desc: Genuinely wants to talk. Its sleep-breath fires first because conversation is easier when the other party isn't moving. If you defeat it, it is mostly just disappointed.

ancient_gold_dragon.name: Ancient Gold Dragon
ancient_gold_dragon.desc: Hoards knowledge in the Deep Dark, not treasure. It knows what is at the bottom. It will not tell you. If you ask it why, it says: because it won't help.

ancient_silver_dragon.name: Ancient Silver Dragon
ancient_silver_dragon.desc: Its cold breath can freeze entire corridors in the Deep Dark. It is down here because the surface became intolerable. It has not specified why. Its eyes are very tired.

storm_dragon.name: Storm Dragon
storm_dragon.desc: Native to the Spine's upper peaks. Driven inward by whatever is below floor 46. It does not know what drove it. It knows it was afraid. Storm dragons are not afraid of things.

shadow_dragon.name: Shadow Dragon
shadow_dragon.desc: Lives in the space between forge-fires. Necrotic breath. It is not shadow-colored — it is shadow-shaped. The difference matters when you try to hit it.

crystal_dragon.name: Crystal Dragon
crystal_dragon.desc: Aeridorian-made. Breathes resonance rather than fire. Its scales refract light incorrectly. Elara has one note in her journal about crystal dragons and it just says 'no.'

void_dragon.name: Void Dragon
void_dragon.desc: No breath weapon. No element. It nullifies. Magic fails near it. Equipment stops functioning correctly. Reality in its immediate vicinity is a suggestion rather than a constraint.

aeridor_wyrm.name: Aeridor Wyrm
aeridor_wyrm.desc: Not exactly a dragon. A dragon-shaped resonance entity native to the depths. The Aeridorian archives classified it as infrastructure. The archives were wrong, but only slightly.

foreman_kregg.name: Foreman Kregg
foreman_kregg.desc: The Ironclad Guild's enforcer in the deep tunnels. Doesn't ask questions. Follows Valdric's orders. A pickaxe in one hand, a weighted chain in the other.

the_unburied.name: The Unburied
the_unburied.desc: A miner who died in the abandoned section and didn't stay dead. The Guild lantern still clips to his belt. He remembers the way out. He can never leave.

resonance_warden.name: Resonance Warden
resonance_warden.desc: An Aeridorian construct of pure crystal. Built to protect the resonance vein. It has been doing so for a thousand years. It is very good at its job.

the_last_of_the_party.name: The Last of the Party
the_last_of_the_party.desc: He was the mining party's leader. He found what was sealed. He wasn't strong enough to resist it. His pickaxe is still in his hand. His eyes are not his own.

the_bound_architect.name: The Bound Architect
the_bound_architect.desc: The thing that built the deep vault. Still here. Still building. It is not Aeridorian — it is what the Aeridorians found and tried to contain. It has been patient. It is finished waiting.

wood_spider.name: Wood Spider
wood_spider.desc: A small, hairy forest arachnid that drops from branches.

decayed_shambler.name: Decayed Shambler
decayed_shambler.desc: A minor pile of animate leaves and rotting twigs.

whisperwood_crayfish.name: Whisperwood Crayfish
whisperwood_crayfish.desc: An aggressive, armored crustacean guarding shallow pools.

forest_adder.name: Forest Adder
forest_adder.desc: A venomous snake camouflaged in the undergrowth.

briar_slime.name: Briar Slime
briar_slime.desc: A green ooze studded with sharp thorns.

canopy_leaper.name: Canopy Leaper
canopy_leaper.desc: A small, highly athletic mammal that pounces from above.

trade_road_highwayman.name: Highwayman
trade_road_highwayman.desc: A desperate cutthroat shaking down merchants on the Trade Road.

mossy_troll.name: Mossy Troll
mossy_troll.desc: A lumbering beast covered in thick moss and lichen.

shadow_wisp.name: Shadow Wisp
shadow_wisp.desc: A pulsing orb of dark energy that drains warmth.

ruin_crawler.name: Ruin Crawler
ruin_crawler.desc: A centipede-like scavenger nesting in Aeridorian rubble.

stone_construct.name: Stone Construct
stone_construct.desc: A small guardian made of granite, animated by ancient magic.

mud_golem.name: Mud Golem
mud_golem.desc: A shifting pile of wet earth and clay.

cave_bear.name: Cave Bear
cave_bear.desc: A massive, scarred bear nesting in subterranean caverns.

aeridorian_sentinel.name: Aeridorian Sentinel
aeridorian_sentinel.desc: An ancient bronze automation patrolling the ruins.

whispering_shade.name: Whispering Shade
whispering_shade.desc: A lingering soul that feeds on the sanity of travelers.

bog_hag.name: Bog Hag
bog_hag.desc: A wicked spellcaster dwelling in the swampy depths.

drake_hatchling.name: Drake Hatchling
drake_hatchling.desc: A small but fierce reptilian beast breathing embers.

ruin_gorgon.name: Ruin Gorgon
ruin_gorgon.desc: A petrifying monstrosity stalking the deepest Aeridorian chambers.

cave_hydra.name: Cave Hydra
cave_hydra.desc: A multi-headed reptilian horror that regenerates rapidly.

whisperwood_terror.name: Whisperwood Terror
whisperwood_terror.desc: A colossal, mutated plant creature with crushing vines.

void_stalker_prime.name: Void Stalker Prime
void_stalker_prime.desc: An apex predator of the dark void, phasing between realities.

chimera.name: Chimera
chimera.desc: A horrific fusion of lion, goat, and serpent.

gorgon_queen.name: Gorgon Queen
gorgon_queen.desc: The legendary ruler of the ruins, whose gaze turns blood to stone.

ancient_behemoth.name: Ancient Behemoth
ancient_behemoth.desc: A mythic beast of pure muscle and rage, sealed for centuries.

void_wraith_lord.name: Void Wraith Lord
void_wraith_lord.desc: A dark entity commanding the shadow hosts of the Deepwood.

titan_golem.name: Titan Golem
titan_golem.desc: A towering colossus of stone and steel defending the ancient core.
